updateNotice.title: Updated to {{version}}
updateNotice.noNotes: The notes for this version are on its release page.
updateNotice.optIns: Downloading and installing updates are now two separate choices in Settings › Updates, both off: nothing is downloaded or installed until you turn them on or press the button. Check for updates keeps the value it had.

engineSwitch.downloadBody: Changing the inference engine restarts Erudi's engine, which cancels the model download in progress. You will have to start it again from the beginning.

fileReasons.unreadable: damaged, protected by a password, or not the format its extension says
fileReasons.pending_vision: no extractable text (a scan or an image), and text recognition is not bundled yet
fileReasons.unsupported: a file type that is not supported
fileReasons.failed: the app could not extract its text
fileReasons.empty_folder: no supported document in this folder
fileReasons.too_many: only the first {{limit}} files were attached
